info.name: Shyft Customer Authentication > Email Deprecated API

items.docs:
For the first time, please have `confirm=true` to active this account. otherwise it is not considred as geneated account.

Once succeeded. Please extract these fields from `Headers` returned: 

`access-token, expiry, token-type, uid, client`

And please include these headers in your future API calls for authentication purpose. 

`expiry` returns Unix epoch time in seocnds.
